requirements.requirement: Meta scheduled post mutations must reject timezone-free, impossible-calendar and out-of-range-offset timestamps before calling the remote API.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: The adapter uses isValidZonedIsoTimestamp and rejects missing timezone, impossible calendar date, invalid hour/minute and UTC offsets outside the allowed range before any external mutation. The exact-SHA test asserts no request is made for invalid timestamps.
requirements.nextAction: Retain the adapter regression test and apply strict timezone-qualified timestamp validation at every external scheduling boundary.

requirements.requirement: Caption synchronization must reject syntactically shaped SRT timestamps with impossible minute or second values and report invalid timestamp values explicitly.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: parseSrtTime returns null for minute or second fields above 59; validateCaptionSync reports an invalid SRT timestamp value; regression tests cover 00:60:00,000, 00:00:60,000, and acceptance of timelines with hours >= 24.
requirements.nextAction: Keep strict timestamp validation at all caption parsing and rendering boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Dashboard API body-bearing routes reject unsupported request media types before JSON parsing or mutation, return HTTP 415, and safely drain rejected request bodies.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: readBody accepts application/json with optional media-type parameters; rejects missing or unsupported Content-Type with HTTP 415 before route mutation; drains rejected bodies; regression test submits JSON as text/plain and verifies 415 and a path-safe error. Exact candidate CI passes with zero test skips.
requirements.nextAction: Keep the regression and ensure any future body-bearing API routes use the shared readBody parser. This focused case does not close DASH-001.

requirements.requirement: Dashboard API requests exceeding the 16KB JSON body limit return HTTP 413 and do not mutate persisted state or disclose internal paths.
requirements.nextAction: Retain this regression and include all body-bearing routes in the full dashboard/API acceptance matrix.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Oversized request returns 413; no state mutation occurs; error response does not reveal local filesystem paths.

requirements.requirement: Real dashboard HTTP API rejects malformed JSON, unsupported request media types and request bodies over 16 KiB with explicit status codes and no state mutation or local path disclosure.
requirements.nextAction: Retain this regression on all body-bearing routes as the API acceptance matrix expands.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Against the real local server, malformed JSON returns 400, unsupported content type returns 415, and JSON >16 KiB returns 413; error responses do not disclose the state path and state bytes are unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Authorized content-job creation persists a single job and audit event, exact duplicate requests reuse the existing job, and conflicting requests with the same idempotency key are rejected without a second mutation.
requirements.nextAction: Extend the same persistence/idempotency/concurrency pattern to every state-changing route and test cross-process overlap/restart recovery.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Real HTTP POST /api/jobs creates one queued job and audit event; exact retry returns same job as reused; different inputs with the same key return 409; persisted job/audit counts remain one.

requirements.requirement: An explicit backup output path must never overwrite an existing file; flush backup bytes before reporting success.
requirements.nextAction: This specific overwrite-preservation behavior is tested. Continue separate concurrency, crash/power-loss and operational recovery acceptance under STATE-001 and DEPLOY-001.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: When outputPath already exists, backupState rejects, preserves the original bytes, and cleans up its temporary file. A new backup is finalized without replacement-capable rename; file bytes are fsynced and the parent directory is fsynced on supported POSIX systems.

requirements.requirement: Backups and restores sharing a state directory must not run concurrently or capture a partially committed restore.
requirements.nextAction: Lock-contention behavior is proven. Add real overlapping-process and interrupted-restore drills before marking overall STATE-001 accepted.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Backup acquires the same exclusive state-operation lock as restore, rejects a pre-existing lock without changing it, and writes no backup output while the lock is held.

requirements.requirement: A failed backup validation must release the shared backup/restore operation lock and leave no backup output.
requirements.nextAction: The validation-failure lock cleanup is tested. Continue separate real-process overlap and interrupted-transaction recovery drills before accepting STATE-001.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: When backupState fails because there are no eligible entries, it rejects, removes only its own shared lock, and does not create the requested backup file.

requirements.requirement: Backup must fail closed when a separate process owns the shared backup/restore lock, without changing that process's lock or writing a snapshot.
requirements.nextAction: The cross-process contention behavior is proven. Continue interrupted-restore, process-kill, crash/restart, power-loss and deployment rollback drills before accepting overall STATE-001.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: A child Node process acquires and fsyncs the shared operation lock. backupState rejects, leaves the lock bytes unchanged, writes no backup file, and the child releases only its own lock during fixture cleanup.

requirements.requirement: Do not create a backup snapshot while an interrupted restore transaction journal remains in the state directory.
requirements.nextAction: The journal-present refusal is tested. Continue real process termination during restore and repeated restart-recovery drills; this targeted gate does not accept overall STATE-001.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: When .restore-transaction.json exists, backupState rejects before reading snapshot inputs, preserves the journal, creates no backup output, and removes only its own operation lock.

requirements.requirement: Reject symlinked ancestors of an explicit backup output path before creating any nested output directories.
requirements.nextAction: Keep the regression in the mandatory suite. This is a targeted filesystem-safety acceptance item and does not imply overall backup/restore crash-recovery acceptance.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: A backup output path with a symlinked ancestor is rejected before nested directories are created outside the intended path; no backup output is written and the shared operation lock is released.

requirements.requirement: Demonstrate rollback after a restore process terminates immediately after committing a destination but before normal cleanup.
requirements.nextAction: Extend controlled process termination across each transaction boundary, add disk-full and permission-failure drills, and separately exercise power-loss durability. This targeted acceptance does not replace STATE-001.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: A separate process exits immediately after a destination commit, leaving the journal and lock. After operator-confirmed lock cleanup, recovery restores the exact original bytes, clears the journal, and releases its own lock.

requirements.requirement: The private-upload recovery ledger and operation lock directory must reject symlinked ancestors before creating or writing upload state.
requirements.nextAction: Retain this regression. Continue auditing other file-operation entry points and TOCTOU risks; this targeted filesystem-safety pass does not prove live YouTube acceptance or full crash recovery.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Upload log directory creation must reject any symlinked ancestor before creating descendant directories, ledger files or operation locks.

requirements.requirement: After upload or reconciliation, remote YouTube state must match the exact approved video ID, verified SonicVhibez channel, approved title, and private visibility.
requirements.nextAction: Retain the direct field-mismatch tests. Real OAuth identity, complete history, explicit operation authorization and a provider-side upload/read-back remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Shared read-back validation must reject missing/incorrect remote ID, wrong channel, title mismatch, or any visibility other than private for both new uploads and prior-attempt reconciliation.

requirements.requirement: Generate a reproducible, non-destructive inventory of branch-only and main-only commits, per-commit changed-file summaries, final tree diffs, critical module changes, deletions, and heuristic patch-equivalence evidence.
requirements.nextAction: Human review of all branch-only/main-only commit inventories and critical diffs remains required before integration. Patch equivalence and category labels are heuristic; no merge/rebase/reset/force-push is authorized.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: A full-history run must produce retained machine-readable JSON and human-readable Markdown containing every branch-only/base-only commit and per-commit file status/path summaries without mutating repository history.

requirements.requirement: Rights verification evidence must use a calendar-valid ISO timestamp with an explicit timezone; timezone-free, impossible dates and invalid UTC offsets must fail closed.
requirements.nextAction: Keep strict timestamp validation and regression cases; real-world licence authenticity remains a separate human/external gate.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: createReviewDecision rejects timezone-free timestamps, impossible calendar dates, offsets outside the ISO-8601 limit and malformed values, while accepting valid timezone-qualified timestamps.

requirements.requirement: Human-review receipt creation and reuse must reject a missing, malformed, timezone-free or calendar-invalid reviewedAt timestamp.
requirements.nextAction: Keep receipt timestamp regression tests; the receipt timestamp check is local integrity validation and does not prove the reviewer identity or external rights evidence is authentic.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: createReviewDecision refuses invalid reviewedAt values, and isReviewCurrent returns false for a persisted review whose reviewedAt timestamp is invalid.

requirements.nextAction: Retain the hard block and do not add owner overrides or campaign allowlists for Nature Frontiers product promotions. Existing Metricool schedules are provider-side records and require separate owner review; this code change does not mutate them.
